label: searchMovies.orama_hybrid_search
reason: Hybrid/vector search now requests more hits (limit 1000→1020), increasing index traversal, scoring, and vector payload (includeVectors: true). This is likely the dominant latency contributor and scales with limit.
return_value_change: May return a larger array of hits (up to 1020 vs 1000), increasing downstream CPU/memory for callers and potentially changing which items appear in results.

label: searchMovies.postprocess_hits_and_levenshtein
reason: Post-processing work scales with hit count: mapping hits→candidates (string/number parsing, allocations), Levenshtein-based ordering, and building the hitById map. Increasing search limit increases the amount of data processed here.
return_value_change: Indirectly increases the number of elements traversed/returned due to higher upstream hit limit; returned array content/ordering may shift because re-ranking considers a larger candidate set.

label: rateLimiter.catch.debug_log_overhead
reason: New console.debug in the middleware catch path can add synchronous I/O and error-object formatting overhead; under frequent rate-limit rejections this can noticeably increase request latency and amplify CPU/STDIO contention.

attributes.measures: time spent in newly added console.debug before existing console.error
